verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a regulated, hosted money-movement and multi-currency account service, so self-hosting it is a category error rather than a missing feature. Its licensed payment rails, accounts and cards cannot run on a user's own infrastructure, and buyers comparing business payment accounts would not reasonably ask for this. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable distribution; even the Embedded Flows are described as Wise-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
